about.description: Each town of catalogues/codes/places.json (by GeoNames id) in its NUTS 3 unit, the classification Eurostat and EURES divide Europe by (NUTS 2024; NUTS 2016 for the United Kingdom), placed by GISCO's 1:1 million boundaries (https://gisco-services.ec.europa.eu/distribution/v2/nuts/, © EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries), the Canary and Balearic islands grouped into their provinces; and each country's regions and provinces by code, with their Latin names and their own when they differ. A town's region and province are the codes its own code begins with. The United Kingdom's counties, by the names its offers give, Switzerland's cantons by their German names and other names sources give are apart (otherNames): an area for a place that names no town. Built by builder/tools/nuts.ts.
